items.description: Acquired 2027 second-round and 2028 fifth-round draft picks from Jacksonville Jaguars for S Jessie Bates III.
Elevated WR Trent Sherfield and DB Geno Stone from the practice squad. Placed WR Josh Palmer on injured reserve.
Acquired DB Andre Cisco from the New York Jets for a 2028 sixth-round draft pick. Waived TE Jackson Meeks.
Reinstated LB Dorian Mausi from injured reserve. Placed LB James Williams on injured reserve. Signed LB Jimmy Ciarlo to the practice squad. Released DB Derrick Canteen from the practice squad.
Signed WR Odell Beckham Jr. from the practice squad to the active roster. Elevated DB Tavierre Thomas from the practice squad. Placed RB Demond Claiborne on injured reserve.
Waived TE Tanner Arkin. Released LB Jose Ramirez from the practice squad.
Acquired a 2028 sixth-round draft pick from Jacksonville Jaguars for NT Davon Godchaux.
Signed LB Troy Reeder from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed LB Mykal Walker to the practice squad.
Reinstated WR Brandon Aiyuk from the reserve/left squad list.
Acquired S Jessie Bates III from Atlanta for 2027 second-round and 2028 fifth-round draft picks. Acquired NT Davon Godchaux from New Orleans for a 2028 sixth-round draft pick.
